reviews.text:
My family took our senior dog, Dexter, to Mission Gorge Animal Hospital today after he was not feeling well and not eating the last few days. Dr. Lee and his entire staff were extremely welcoming, thorough, and professional and we couldn't be happier. We were extremely stressed about our dog and Dr. Lee provided different suggestions and opinions on treatment/plans for our senior dog and never made us feel pressured. He explained things thoroughly in an easy way to understand and encouraged questions during our appointment. It's never easy seeing a senior pet unwell but Dr. Lee and his staff made our visit very pleasant. Thank you, Dr. Lee for helping our dog, Dexter!

We highly recommend Dr. Lee if you're looking for a great vet!
Dr Lee is the best!

Dr Lee is amazing as a provider and a surgeon! He explains everything thoroughly and has very reasonable rates. I've been coming here for decades, and he has performed every major surgery on my pets. I wouldn't take them anywhere else!

I am once again disappointed by the Dr. Lee. He was very rough in cleaning my dogs ear shoving with much force. He proceeded to squeeze ear cleaner into his ears and let him shake his head with the liquid going everywhere.

The worst part was he expressed our dogs anal glands ungloved and after a few minutes of discussion began to assess my dogs eye where he recently received surgery. That is a huge risk for infection. I removed his hands from my dogs face and took my dog home to clean around his eye to prevent what infection may come from his unsanitary practices.

I knew he can be very quick and brutal with his patients but as a simple recheck I decided to keep the appointment. Boy do I regret that. Dr Lee PLEASE WASH YOUR HANDS. PLEASE BE MORE GENTLE WITH YOUR PATIENTS.

Just sharing this review for anyone who does not want to risk what I experienced with this vet.

Love Doctor Lee !
& his wife such a sweetheart. My grooming shop used to be next door to them & they were always so attentive not only to my pets but to my clients who I referred them over. Dr Lee gets right to the point and if you ask me he’s not as expensive as other doctors & is very professional his care for animals radiates through the room. Thank you dr Lee & team -Barbie
Have taken our pets to Dr Lee for years and we could not be happier he truly cares and makes it such any easy experience

I honest think this pet clinic are a scammer . I took my pet to be seen yesterday due to illness. I was charge $435, because Dr Lee said my cat has a kidney failure and dehydration. So they claimed they give him a CBC shot, blood test and fluids. Tell me why my cat died in less than 24 hours after I brought him back home? Early morning the next day. They killed my cat y’all 😭Can we get our money back for that? Less than 24 hours. Someone please help 🙏🏾🙏🏾
I find Dr Lee to be very experienced and helped my dog. An exam is very thorough too.

I understand people can have misdiagnosis with vets. You can also have this with a doctor or hospital. I have 3 Siamese Orientals, two big-eared European and a Lilac. Doc Lee always calls "personally" to ask how the last visit outcome of health report. SOLID!! 💪 Nothing in life is perfect, even YOUR health with gerneral care. 3 1/2yrs of treatment has made (me) feel secure. My cat family is high breed papered Siamese. "This is my choice for 28yrs+, your opinion doesn't matter". They don't push treatment, rob you blind, they give options and don't BURDEN your decision. Life is amazingly complicated and so are your kindred animal spirits 💕
This family owned vet office is a gem.+++
DO NOT GO HERE. False diagnosed my pet and quoted me $900. I went somewhere else the next day and got it taken care of for HALF that amount.

I started taking my dog here when we moved into the neighborhood a few years ago and I love it! No frills, but good service and availability when I've needed which is all I care about. The vet and staff are all very respectful with my dog. Dr. Lee even called to check up on my dog when he was prescribed some medication for joint pain (limping from a strain). I also like that I can be with him when they administer the shots to calm him down because the last vet I was with would take him away from me and it stressed us both out.

Very helpful with decades of experience. Mrs. Lee can be a little difficult to understand at times but she’s very willing to help. Dr. Lee sits and explains the why and how between all treatment options which is very helpful for making treatment decisions.

They treat all kinds of animals but have a lot of experience with cocker spaniels!

Highly recommend making an appointment as walk ins can cost more.
Taco Tuesday are a fantastic deal.
Really good vet, fair price.
Veterinary very thorough in taking care of your animal; shows and explains the health problem well but services  expensive.

I have used Dr Lee for the last three dogs I have owned over a period of 20 years I find him to be very knowledgeable incompetent in his field. he took the time to explain to me what was going on with my dogs. he was able to imitate different forms of breathing to help explain what was going on. he showed me x-rays and explain them to me in detail. when I inquired about how various antibiotics etc worked and why he chose a certain ones I was given a thorough explanation. I was always grateful that he shared his knowledge with me. all my dogs did well under his care

I took my dog to his office because I felt a lump in my dog's upper back. After he examined my dog he said the lump mostly is cancer and he said it was very aggressive, and she needed a surgery today. I was shocked and sad and full of emotions because I have just lost my other dog. My family and I decided to have a day with her before her surgery. We took her the next few days and without any test, he did 4 types of unnecessary procedures on her. She was cut from the top of her chest to the bottom of her stomach which end up getting an infection because her cancer grow back and her stomach started to stretch out, so after few days of surgery, sadly we had to put her to sleep. Dr. Lee did unnecessary surgery on my dog. we spend a lot of money. He never gave us the written instructions to follow after surgery. I am so sad and feel guilty that I didn't listen to my son because he was wondering why he wants to do surgery without doing a test. I feel horrible to have trusted Dr. Lee. I could have had more times with my dog if he wasn't money hunger.

I am done with this vet. I have gone here multiple times, each visit was just okay, but today an unacceptable thing happened. I walked in with my dog and there was an unleashed, unattended dog sunbathing in the lobby window. As I am …
I would only go to Dr Lee if you think your pet has something trivial. Dr Lee does not have the expertise or technology needed to uncover a serious medical problem. He did not for my dog at least. …
We love Dr. Lee, he is the nicest vet, and we have been with him for over 15 years.

my experience here was awful. I will never be back. my 14 week old puppy had a stroke due to a condition and we brought her in to be put to rest. He never examined her, and he barely spoke a sentence to us. He immediately brought her back …
